name: AmeriDental
what_they_do: Family and cosmetic dental practice with two offices (1553 Ruth Road, Suite 3 in North Brunswick and 313 Courtyard Drive in Hillsborough), offering preventive, restorative, endodontic, periodontal, implant, Invisalign and cosmetic work. Site markets itself to families in central New Jersey with a specific nod to Indian families, publishes a special-offers page and 0% financing.
customers: Families across North Brunswick, Hillsborough and central NJ; insurance and self-pay patients; a stated focus on Indian families.

size_signals.signal: Two offices listed in the header of every page (North Brunswick and Hillsborough) with separate phone numbers
One named dentist, Dr. Neelima Paladugu, on a staff page describing a wider 'team' without naming others
Careers page in the footer suggests active hiring
Google rating 4.9 for the North Brunswick location

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited Maps view I could load

website_review.primary_cta: 'Make an Appointment' buttons that go to /contact/ (form only); no booking engine
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No online booking. The contact page has a long Contact Form 7 request form (name, phone, email, preferred contact method, new/existing, desired location, appointment type, referral source, insurance provider, urgent concerns, notes) with no visible CAPTCHA.
website_review.trust_signals: Social profiles linked (X, Facebook, Instagram), 0% interest financing, special offers page, technology page, blog, both office addresses and hours, Google rating not shown on site
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Phone numbers disagree across the site and with Google (home 732-274-0100, contact/office pages 732-785-4019, Google 732-656-8524); mobile home page hero slider renders as a large blank panel; duplicate/overlapping service menu entries (Fillings and Cosmetic Dentistry appear twice)
website_review.search_basics: Good titles and descriptions naming dentist + North Brunswick, ~20 service pages each with a town-targeted URL, sitemap.xml; hours and addresses are real text
top_issues: Three different phone numbers in circulation (site header, contact page, Google listing)
No online scheduling - every appointment request is a form a human must answer
Mobile home page first screen is blank until the slider loads, with no visible CTA

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt only disallows /wp-admin, so all major crawlers including OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot are allowed; however the Google profile shows a different phone number than the website and no 'Book online' button, and hours across the two offices differ, which confuses both humans and agents. Answerable: hours for both offices, addresses, service list and insurance/financing text are crawlable, but the only JSON-LD is an Organization graph with no Dentist/LocalBusiness node carrying hours or price range, and the page never states prices. Bookable: form-only - no availability, no confirmation, placeholder-labelled inputs rather than proper labels.

operations_signals.signal: Appointment requests land in a long form covering insurance and urgency, implying staff manually triage and call back each one
North Brunswick office is part-time (Mon/Tue/Fri 1-7pm, Wed closed, Thu/Sat 10-3) while Hillsborough runs separate hours - staff must route patients between sites
Careers link in the footer (inference: hiring/understaffed front desk), page itself not reviewed

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the name/address/phone mess and claim-complete the Google profiles: one phone number everywhere, per-location hours and services, booking link
top_opportunities.evidence: Home header says (732) 274-0100, contact and office pages say (732) 785-4019, Google Maps shows (732) 656-8524 - three numbers for one practice

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add real online scheduling (per location) so a patient's agent can book without a phone call, with the form shortened to a fallback
top_opportunities.evidence: Every CTA points to a 9-field contact form; nothing on the site offers available times

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the mobile home page: load the hero instantly, put a click-to-call and a book button above the fold, and stop stacking two office addresses at the very top
top_opportunities.evidence: At 390px the first screen was two address lines, a logo, a hamburger and an empty white hero panel

scores.reasons: Gap: solid content depth but broken mobile hero, no scheduling and inconsistent contact data. Pay: two-location practice with implant/Invisalign mix and financing partnerships. Ease: NAP cleanup, scheduling embed and a mobile hero fix are all short engagements. Evidence: visited home, contact, office and doctor pages, robots.txt and Google Maps profile; reviewed mobile at 390px.
